policies.title: Cabo Verdean ordinary passports: Jordan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: The official Jordan Tourism Board's live nationality table states that Cabo Verde nationals are not eligible for visa on arrival and must obtain a visa before arrival.
conditions: Applies to Cabo Verdean ordinary-passport short visitors, who must contact the nearest Jordanian embassy and obtain a visa before travel.
Complete the Gateway2Jordan pre-departure registration and obtain its QR code before travel.
This policy does not cover work, residence, special travel documents, conditional third-country-document routes, or final admission.

policies.title: Cabo Verdean ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Cabo Verde in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring consular filing and approval before travel unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Cabo Verdean passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa applicants must appear in person at the consulate; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on verification and document completion.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person at the competent Panamanian consulate with the required authorized-visa application documents.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the authorized visa has been granted.

policies.title: Cabo Verdean ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry schedule says Cabo Verde ordinary-passport holders require a visa; its eVisa route is conditional on specified third-country visas or residence permits.
conditions: The passport-only baseline requires a visa before travel.
A separate 30-day single-entry eVisa route may apply only with a qualifying Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland visa or residence permit and the eVisa service's other criteria.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback says visa on arrival, while Jordan's current official nationality table expressly says Cabo Verde is not arrival-eligible and requires a visa before travel.

The fallback treats Türkiye as an eVisa route, while the current Foreign Ministry schedule requires ordinary Cabo Verde passports to hold a visa and limits eVisa eligibility to holders of qualifying third-country documents.
